dishes.pairing_mechanics: Cold water with a clean, light mineral taste cuts through smoky fat and onion sharpness and refreshes the palate between skewers; bottle condensation next to the grill is a strong visual contrast of fire vs cold
dishes.physiological_impact: Smoke, salt and pepper dry the mouth; charred fat is rich and heavy; raw onion leaves a sharp aftertaste; eaten outdoors in heat, which adds to thirst
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Lamb, beef or liver on skewers alternating with fat pieces, charcoal smoke, black pepper, cumin, raw onion with vinegar and dill; served with non

framework.name: PEPSI_BEHAVIORAL_DOPAMINE

do: Lead with the sound of the cap or ice
dont: More than 12 words of on-screen text
Showing drinking during Ramadan fasting hours
voiceover.music: Upbeat Uzbek pop / trap beat with a hard drop on the first sip
voiceover.voice: Young, energetic; or no voiceover and ASMR sound design only (bottle cap click, ice, pour, exhale)

framework.visual_style: High-key hard sunlight, heat-haze shimmer, macro shots of condensation droplets running down the bottle, ice cracking, 120fps slow-motion pour intercut with fast 0.5-1s cuts, whip pans, cold blue-teal grade on the product vs warm orange grade on the environment, product visible in the first 1.5 seconds
framework.neural_target: Dopamine reward pathway (ventral striatum) & gustatory / insular cortex (temperature and thirst signals)
framework.narrative_tone: Energetic, punchy, youthful, sensory; short sentences, onomatopoeia (pshhh, click, glug)
framework.primary_trigger: Instant refreshment through contrast: heat vs ice, heavy vs light, thirst vs relief. The viewer should almost physically feel the first cold sip.
framework.selection_rationale: Live temperature ≥35°C: thirst drive dominates, refreshment contrast converts best.

guardrails.note: Encourage regular drinking; do not frame heat as fun for vulnerable groups (elders, babies).

month_context: Peak Chilla heat, peak ice-water demand, late-night gatherings

primary_event.emotional_state: Physical exhaustion, irritability, desperate craving for cold, relief-seeking; nights become the social time
cultural_rituals: Sleeping on tapchans in the courtyard at night
Late-night street food and family walks after 21:00
primary_event.physiological_state: Extreme thermal stress +40°C to +45°C (up to +47°C in Termez); rapid fluid and salt loss, headaches, heat exhaustion risk, loss of appetite in daytime

tone_modifiers: Mention the live temperature on screen
visual_modifiers: Heat haze + macro condensation in first 1.5s
